versions.changelog:
Initial release of ISO Multi-Standard Audit Assistant.

- Supports 28 management-system standards, including ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 27001, 20000, and more.
- Provides plain-language clause interpretation, document parsing, gap analysis, and one-click generation of standard-format system documents.
- Enables automatic conversion of legacy documents into audit-ready formats.
- Features a step-by-step workflow for standard confirmation, document review, gap analysis, document generation, and mock audits.
- Offers both general and standard-specific data/templates for comprehensive coverage.
